reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the 1–10 person business owner-operator in Bareni's calm, pragmatic tone, honoring the no-CTA rule and human approval constraints.
reasons.clarity: The workflow decision is introduced immediately and explained with crisp, logical progression and unambiguous scoping.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-friction diagnostic procedure (a one-week manual test) with concrete metrics to determine if automation is warranted.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to evidence boundaries; contains no fabricated customers, metrics, deployments, or unsupported capability claims.
